- Meet Elizabeth at Chinatown starting at 18:54 (after 6-minute travel from North Beach) and ending at 20:09 (75 minutes).  
- Meet Carol at Haight-Ashbury starting at 21:30 (after travel from Chinatown, with idle time) and ending at 22:30 (60 minutes).  

Idle times occur between meetings (e.g., at The Castro from 10:28 to 11:19 and at Chinatown from 20:09 to 21:11) but are not included in the JSON as they are not meeting actions. All minimum meeting times are met or exceeded, and all constraints are satisfied.
